reply_text:
Status: most Codex turns are already labelled correctly. The unknown ones come from three unregistered loop scripts, and I'm fixing how those are classified.Tests pass. Reloading the namespace into the running Agency (a reload from master is allowed), then checking it live.I've fixed it: turns from your loop scripts are now labelled as automatic, and the fix is live in the running Agency. Codex logging was already mostly right, and I was wrong last time to say relayed turns were marked unknown. The file I sampled happened to be a solve-loop seat, and I generalised from it.

I counted the headers in your last 60 Codex sessions:

| Who sent it | Origin written | Turns |
|---|---|---|
| Claude seats belling Codex (claude-8, claude-17, claude-9…) | agent | ~7,500 |
| You at the Emacs REPL | operator | 1,031 |
| Auto-bellbacks, park resumes | harness | ~1,460 |
| **solve-loop, topology-build-loop, topology-supervisor** | **unknown** | **~8,000** |

The last row was the only problem. Those three are scheduler scripts in apm-lean that send with `agency_send --from <name>`. They aren't registered agents, so Agency deliberately wouldn't guess and wrote "unknown". I've added them to the list of known automatic senders, so their turns now say `Origin: harness`. A sender Agency doesn't recognise still gets "unknown", so it never guesses.

**Checked:**
- The origin tests pass with a new case for each script. Without the fix, each of those cases would come out "unknown".
- clj-kondo and the paren check are clean.
- After reloading the namespace in the live Agency, it classifies all three scripts as harness and still returns unknown for a made-up caller.

This only affects new turns. Logs already written keep "unknown", and the log reader skips those turns anyway, since it counts only operator turns as yours. Your gaps were already measured from the 1,031 turns you typed at the REPL, so the chart doesn't change.

If you add another loop script later, it will show as unknown until its name is added to `harness-sources` in `src/futon3c/evidence/origin.clj`. Registering loops by some other means would be a bigger change, and I haven't made it.

Commit: futon3c 711fc343.
